{{lang|pt|'''Canja de galinha'''}} ({{IPA|pt-PT|kɐ̃ʒɐ ðɨ ɣɐˈlĩɲɐ|eu}}, {{IPA|pt-BR|kɐ̃ʒɐ dʒi gaˈlĩj̃ɐ|br}}, (literally "chicken [[congee]]"), or simply {{lang|pt|'''canja'''}}, is a popular [[chicken soup]] of [[Portuguese cuisine|Portuguese]], [[Cape Verdean cuisine|Cape Verdean]], and [[Brazilian cuisine|Brazilian]] cuisine.<ref name="g">{{Cite Q|Q124605077}}</ref> The [[Portuguese language|Portuguese]] term {{lang|pt|galinha}} literally means "hen", but became the generic name for the species, much like [[chicken]] in English. Portuguese chicken congee has the rice much more cooked than in most Western chicken soup recipes, but it is not disintegrated as in the Asian one.
